In [108]:
preds = []
for i in range(len(pred_period)):
    ts = rail_series[origin:pred_period.shift(-1)[i]].reset_index()
    ts.columns = ["ds", "y"]
    model = Prophet()
    model.fit(ts)
    future = model.make_future_dataframe(periods=1)
    forecast = model.predict(future)
    pred = forecast["yhat"].iloc[-1]
    preds.append(pred)

In [123]:
preds = []
for i in range(len(pred_period)):
    ts = rail_series[origin:pred_period.shift(-1)[i]].reset_index()
    ts.columns = ["ds", "y"]
    model = Prophet()
    model.fit(ts)
    future = model.make_future_dataframe(periods=1)
    forecast = model.predict(future)
    pred = forecast["yhat"].iloc[-1]
    preds.append(pred)
